guardedDirs.description: Repo-relative directories the main session may not write to.

docs.description: "path — description" lines shown at session start.

healthScript.description: Repo-relative script run with --fast at session start; not run when it resolves outside the project root or is a symlink.

graph.description: Code graph (graphify). Present = enabled: the handoff refreshes it and the codebase-question hint reports its staleness.

root.description: Repo-relative directory the graph covers ("." = whole repo). Must match the directory the graph was built from.

maxCommitsBehind.description: Commits under root since the last refresh before the hint says to refresh before answering.

refreshScript.description: Repo-relative script that replaces the builtin refresh (run from the repo root; exit 0 = refreshed); not run when it resolves outside the project root or is a symlink.

remote.description: Remote-command guard and change windows. Absent: the guard is off. Present (even empty): deploy pushes and server changes need a user-approved change window.

deployBranches.description: Branches whose push triggers a deploy (branch:<name> targets).

hosts.description: Hosts treated as production servers (host:<name> targets). A single * matches every host.

readOnlyFirstWords.description: Remote commands whose first word (or first two, joined with a dash) is read-only and needs no window.

windowMinutes.description: How long an approved change window stays open.

runbooksDir.description: Repo-relative directory of runbooks a change plan may reference.

log.description: Repo-relative file where closed windows are recorded.

scratch.description: Temp-space hygiene for agent scratch directories.

agentMaxMB.description: New scratchpad files (MB) a subagent may leave behind; at or above it the SubagentStop gate blocks the subagent from returning.

staleAfterHours.description: Hours after which scratch data counts as stale.

reportMinMB.description: Minimum total scratch size (MB) worth reporting.

minFreeGB.description: Free space (GB) below which memokit warns.

dropWarnGB.description: Free-space drop (GB) during a single Bash command that triggers a warning.

maxCoders.description: Maximum coder subagents running at once.

maxReviewers.description: Maximum reviewer subagents running at once.

model.description: Reviewer model: auto picks by risk.

careful.description: Destructive-command guard. Project patterns are added to the builtin set; they can only add, never remove.

match.description: POSIX ERE (grep -E), case-insensitive, matched against the whole command text.

label.description: Short name shown in the deny message.

target.description: Optional change-window target name (pattern:<target>). When set, a user-approved change window for this target lets the matching command through.
